title: Media Manager Lazy Load | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Media Manager Lazy Load Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000049983 When the Media Manager holds a large number of images, a lazy-load option appears within the manager. Two controls are available: Load More Loads an additional 10 images per click, allowing fast browsing through the folder. Load All Loads every image in the folder at once. NOTE: Selecting Load All may take several seconds to several minutes to complete, depending on how many images the folder contains.
